owner_ruling.meaning: R10 failed only its manipulation check because the burner dose was derived from nproc (10, capped by OMP_NUM_THREADS=10) on a host with 20 logical CPUs, so the planted load never made runnable tasks wait. The owner rules that R10 is re-run once as R10c with that setup error fixed. If R10c passes, row R10 is resolved PASS by this ruling and calibration 2 is checked off (summary.overall_pass_owner_ruling = true). The original pre-registered verdict (summary.overall_pass = false) stays recorded, unchanged, beside it. If R10c fails or is inconclusive, calibration 2 stays FAIL.
owner_ruling.verbatim: ok can we run just that one test w/ the setup error fixed? then it can be fully checked off

row.change: identical to R10/R10b (tools/calib_eval.sh full pipeline) except the planted-load dose: burners = 1.5 x getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN (= 30 on this host; the runner aborts if the logical CPU count is not 20), started inside each screen and confirm task/spot_gtk3_text quiet-timed block by tools/with-load.sh via tools/run_blocks_loaded.py. getconf is used because OMP_NUM_THREADS does not cap it (nproc does). row.expect: trace-off agreement passes on a real deletion under CPU contention
row.ledger: cal2-amend2-results.jsonl = byte copy of cal2-amend-results.jsonl (13 lines) extended by the R10c evaluations, so LORD++ continues from all earlier p-values; earlier ledgers are not modified
row.pass_if: identical to R10b, on each of the first two assessable repeats: (1) the screen ranks; (2) gates.g7 (unmodified, the repeat's own prereg) on its confirm rows passes (mechanism share >= 0.7 and the trace-unset Delta inside the traced CI95 widened by ln(1+tau)), whether or not an earlier gate stopped the pipeline; (3) manipulation check: the median per-trial cpu 'some' PSI stall share (psi.cpu_some_stall_us / (t_exit_ns - t_spawn_ns)) of its confirm task trials exceeds the median of the ten unloaded R3 repeats' per-repeat medians (0.00352), and the median loadavg_end[0] of its confirm task trials is >= 14. The pipeline verdict is reported (expected KEEP) but is not part of pass_if.
row.repeats: 2 assessable repeats, tag delete50-load30c, seeds by the calibration-2 formula with i = 22 (screen 20261102 + 22000 + 10r + 1, confirm ... + 2). A repeat is assessable if its confirm task rows exist. A repeat that stops (INFRA/REJECT) before its confirm task rows exist is replaced by the next repeat number (r03, r04), at most twice; if fewer than 2 repeats are assessable after r04 the row is INCONCLUSIVE (= not passed).
row.reported_not_gated: screen and confirm T_act sigma_ln, champion-arm median T and T_act vs unloaded R3, failures, verdicts, non-assessable repeats
